out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported inability to touch objects (cord/doorknob), could not be heard, could not see self in mirror; later floated above body and became unable to move.

arrival.other_being_detail: A beautiful androgynous young being near the door, feet blending into air; glow green then blue then white; communicated telepathically; said "I am here to help you"; called experiencer by an unknown name; said he was a great "master" and had forgotten who he was; claimed to have been with him always and proved it by recounting childhood actions and even thoughts.

environment.environment_other_detail: Viewed Earth ('Gaia') and its aura from space/moon; traveled to Egypt/pyramids, Southwest US, across Earth and solar system; saw 'great city in the clouds'/'spirit city' with white buildings; 'living wood' interior; garden; river used for return; saw auras/energies and heard planetary energies.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Also framed as being 'necessary for the universe' and to help Gaia/humans return to harmony; importance of children he was 'needed to bring to Gaia'.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Escort took him to a river, touched him on what would be his lips, said if he jumped into the river he would find his way back to his body; he jumped and returned.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he was needed on Gaia to help souls bring themselves and Gaia back to harmony; to 'learn and share with others using the gifts' accumulated over several lifetimes; message associated with Jesus: 'Tell them to love one another'; importance of children he was needed to bring to Gaia (one singled out as integral to Gaia's future).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug overdose at a party; later specified: thought THC but actually PCP cut with rat poison; he threw party intending to leave town to try to heal himself from what he later learned was clinical depression.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: He states he believed in God then, though was angry at God.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Remote travel/instantaneous movement by thought; viewing auras/energies; encounters with 'dark souls' (earthbound spirits); cosmic/planetary travel; 'city in the clouds' and service-center buildings; river return method.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in house with inability to interact, then helper/light being appears; extensive travels (Earth/space/planets) and encounters; later heavenly city/service center; then evaluative council and life review; then decision/negotiation and return via river.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prolonged 'spirit travel' to Egypt, across Earth, into space and across solar system; detailed cosmology about Gaia's aura/energy, planetary themes for soul evolution; 'dark souls' earthbound spirits; heavenly 'service center' city with jobs; evaluative council (explicitly 'not judges'); return by jumping into a river after guide touches his lips; reported seeing all rooms at once and inability to manipulate physical objects during OBE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I am here to help you"; "Tell them to love one another."; "I was home and I knew it."; "Where I was, time did not really exist."
